caption: The drawing depicts a stylized archway composed of two vertical columns and an ornate, curved top section. The columns are colored in a reddish-brown hue with base and capital details, and they stand atop a light blue horizontal ground line. Each column's base has a decorative roughly crescent-shaped flourish. The top section of the arch curves upward in a wave-like manner, ending in spiral shapes on either side, and is outlined in reddish-brown and filled with evenly spaced blue circles. The inner side of the arch is decorated with a scalloped edge, colored in reddish-brown and blue. At the apex and at each end of the curved top, three simple crosses in reddish-brown extend vertically. The background is a light greyish tone, and the drawing is on an off-white paper. In the bottom right corner, a small signature is visible.
title: Wall Painting
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
